Exam Date & Time: 09-May-2025 (02:30 PM - 05:30 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  Manipal Institute of Technology, Bengaluru  
  BTech VI Semester  
  End Semester Examination - April / May -2025  
  VISION SENSORS [CSE-4016]  
Marks: 50                                                                             Duration: 180 mins.  
  PART-A  
Answer all the questions.  
1)              Analyse the role of Modulation Transfer Function (MTF) in evaluating the  
  performance of an optical system.  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)         Summarize how aerial cameras contribute to remote sensing applications.               (5)  
2)              Categorize different types of lens aberrations and explain their impact on image  
  quality.  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)         List and explain the principles involved in image reconstruction in Computed  
  Tomography and analyse their contribution to the final image clarity.                 (5)  
  
3)              Apply the concept of spectral resolution to differentiate between hyperspectral and  
  multispectral images  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)         Distinguish between image acquisition techniques using a single sensor and sensor  
  arrays.                                                                               (5)  
  
4)              Infer how the sampling in the wavelength domain influences the representation of  
  colour in digital images  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)         Compare the performance of CCD and CMOS sensors                                       (5)  
5)              Illustrate the working of CCD sensors  
  (3)  
  A)  
  B)         Explain the concept of emissivity in Infrared Thermography                            (2)  
  C)         List and explain the principles involved in image reconstruction in Computed  
  Tomography and analyse their contribution to the final image clarity.                 (5)  
  
  
-----End-----
